message.content:
The front cover of Tempo magazine, dated 24-30 Agustus 2015, features a stylized editorial illustration of a man in a business suit. The man, wearing glasses and a red tie, leans forward with an aggressive expression. His right hand is oversized, pointing a thick index finger directly toward the viewer, while his left hand is tucked behind his back. In the foreground, another large hand emerges from the bottom edge, also pointing its index finger upward toward the central figure.

The background consists of a teal-colored halftone pattern, framed by a thick red border on the left and bottom sides. Large white letters spell out "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, the text reads "RIZAL RAMLI" and "PETARUNG ATAU PERAUNG" in large, bold white font. Other legible text includes "SEBELAS MENIT SEBELUM TRIGANA MENDARAT," "POPCON 2015: GENERASI MUDA BISNIS DIGITAL," and pricing information with a barcode at the bottom left: "RP 39.500," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273."
